title: Laurance Rockefeller's family pressured him over meeting Greer
summary: Steven Greer tells of Laurance Rockefeller's family pressured him over meeting Greer, about September 1993 at JY Ranch, Teton County, Wyoming, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: They didn't want he he said they are already jumping up and down on my nuts.

plain: Steven Greer, a man who runs a campaign for the government to reveal what it knows about UFOs, says he met the wealthy philanthropist Laurance Rockefeller at his JY Ranch in Teton County, Wyoming, in September 1993. Greer says Rockefeller told him his family, including his relatives David and Jay Rockefeller, did not want him meeting Greer and were already, in his crude words, jumping up and down on him about it. If true, it would mean one of America's richest families was uneasy about the UFO question.
